item.title: ICE 4 verlässt Zürich – 8 Stunden bis Hamburg
item.description: ICE 4 der Deutschen Bahn verlässt Zürich HB und startet seine rund 8-stündige Fahrt nach Hamburg. Die Reise führt über Basel, Freiburg, Offenburg, Karlsruhe, Mannheim, Frankfurt, Kassel, Göttingen und Hannover bis nach Hamburg. Einblicke in eine lange ICE-Fahrt durch die Schweiz und Deutschland.

item.title: ETH-Zurich: TERRA - Rare Earth Element Extraction with Algae (2025) - Project Promotion [English]
item.description:
**Title:** TERRA - Rare Earth Element Extraction with Algae
**Description:** Rare earth elements are essential for smartphones, electric cars, wind turbines, and more — but less than 1% are recycled. Mining new REEs is costly, environmentally damaging, and tied to global supply risks. TERRA (Tfd Expressing RRE Recovering Algae) uses genetically engineered microalgae that can absorb even trace amounts of REEs from waste, including toxic red mud from aluminium production.
